styleSource.notes: Four oracular registers (AI Oracle, Celestial, Botanical, Carnival Huckster), each paired with two mythprint photo-collage style tags (8 style tag variants total). Fortune text generated by the caption pass is the single source of truth; code-rolled seed values are injected into the fortune-text prompt only and must never be re-injected into the image style tag.

_extensions.lockedRule: Seed values (number, color, date) are injected into the fortune-text generation prompt only. They must never be re-injected into or duplicated within the image style tag. This was previously over-engineered and corrected; do not regress this rule when implementing.
